class.name: TwoVoipOpusEncoder
class.brief_description: Encodes one already-conditioned PCM chunk with Opus.
class.description: The encoder owns no PCM, rewind or lead-frame buffer. Pass one complete output-rate chunk to [method encode_chunk].

method.name: encode_chunk
method.description: Encodes exactly one configured chunk and prepends optional transport bytes. Returns an empty array on failure.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Creates the Opus encoder. The sample rate and frame size must be supported by Opus.

method.name: reset
method.description: Resets libopus state before an unrelated stream.

method.name: set_inband_perc
method.description: Sets expected packet loss, or disables in-band FEC with -1.
